editorial:
You follow Joong-ho, a former cop who now runs a shady escort business and is losing money fast because several of his workers have vanished without paying their debts. When he notices that every missing girl was last called by the same mysterious client, he races to stop his current girl from meeting that same man. The story pulls you in right away with its gritty streets, tense phone calls, and a ticking-clock feeling that never lets up. It is dark, fast, and full of moral gray areas, so you never quite know who to root for.

The acting is strong, especially the lead who makes you feel his panic and guilt even when he is doing bad things. The action is raw and realistic, with chases and fights that feel messy and real instead of polished. On the downside, the violence can be hard to watch and the pacing slows a bit in the middle. If you enjoy dark crime thrillers with real stakes, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, Joong-ho finally catches the killer, but the police let him go due to lack of evidence, which drives Joong-ho to take matters into his own hands. He tracks the killer down and brutally attacks him, but the killer survives and is arrested again. The last scene shows Joong-ho sitting alone, broken and empty, realizing that even his revenge could not save the missing girls or fix his own broken life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark crime thrillers with real stakes.
